Data

Data

Machine-readable music theory data for use in apps, tooling, and analysis.

These files are plain JSON. They're intended to be consumed directly rather than rendered into HTML. Each file documents its schema in the repo.

Intervals

13 intervals: semitone count, short code, approximate just-intonation and 12-TET ratios, cents.
